services.name: Dental consultation · Smile Forward
services.desc: Dental health, smile goals and practical planning in one conversation. Oral health comes first; a plan before a commitment.

services.name: Clear aligner assessment
services.desc: Dental and bite assessment to discuss whether removable aligners suit your teeth, bite and routine, compared with other options.

services.name: Smile correction consultation
services.desc: Talk through gaps, uneven edges, alignment or tooth-colour concerns, conservative options first, and receive an individual proposal.

services.name: Acne & breakout consultation
services.desc: Assessment of active acne and your routine, with laser or light options discussed only when appropriate.

services.name: Acne marks & scars consultation
services.desc: Distinguish colour changes from scarring and discuss suitable treatments, recovery and realistic expectations.

services.name: Wart & bump assessment
services.desc: Clinical identification first, then options for confirmed warts. Laser is considered for selected cases.

services.name: Laser hair reduction consultation
services.desc: Private consultation for face, underarm, leg or body areas: skin tone and hair review, honest expectations and a written proposal.

services.name: Bridal & event skin consultation
services.desc: Plan skin care around your wedding or event date, with a realistic preparation timeline and a personalised bundle.

services.name: Hair & scalp assessment · Root & Reset
services.desc: Review of shedding or thinning, scalp, nutrition, sleep and stress, with targeted tests only if indicated.

services.name: PRP consultation for hair loss
services.desc: Discuss whether platelet-rich plasma suits your diagnosed hair-loss concern, the procedure, sessions and alternatives.

services.name: EMS wellness consultation
services.desc: An introduction to electrical muscle stimulation and whether it fits your wellness goals. Suitability first.

services.name: Weight management consultation
services.desc: A conversation about your weight, routine and goals before choosing a programme.
